_README: Generated by tools/build_stimulus_set.ts (npm run set:build); do not edit. Checked by analysis/check_stimulus_set.py (npm run set:check). See README.md in this folder.

inputs.cloud_section_hash_rule: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 canonical JSON of the stimulus.cloud section: comment keys starting with "_" removed, keys sorted, no whitespace, numbers as JSON.stringify writes them
inputs.distribution_hash_rule: SHA-256 of the raw bytes of the file

seed_rule: candidate j of a target is generateCloud (src/stimulus/cloud.ts) with seed seedFrom(set_id, count, size_third, spacing_third, j) of src/core/rng.ts; a failed placement restarts by the rule of generateCloud
selection_rule: r* = median hull-to-field ratio (convex hull area of the dot centres / field area) over every candidate of every target of the set, computed before any scaling. For each target, five non-negative deviations per candidate: (a) |hull-to-field ratio - r*|, (b) centroid offset from the field centre (deg), (c) |nearest-neighbour mean - median nearest-neighbour mean of the target candidates| (deg), (d) nearest-neighbour standard deviation (deg), (e) half-field imbalance = |dark - bright| summed over the left, right, top and bottom half-fields. The five quantities are computed from the candidate values as written in the file (10 significant digits). Each quantity is scaled, not centred: divided by its root mean square over the K target candidates (0 for every candidate when that root mean square is at most 1e-9 of the largest absolute value). Score = sum of the five squared scaled quantities, rounded to 10 significant digits. The kept candidate has the smallest score, so the smallest deviations; equal scores are a tie and the lowest candidate index wins. The median of an even number of values is the mean of the two middle values.

conventions.dots: [x_deg, y_deg, polarity]: centre in degrees of visual angle from the field centre, x right, y down; every dot has the diameter target.dot_diameter_deg
conventions.thirds: size_third across the log2 Size range, spacing_third across the log2 Spacing range, 0 = smallest; the fraction of a third is its centre, (third + 0.5) / n_thirds
conventions.half_fields: left x < 0, right x >= 0, top y < 0, bottom y >= 0; value = dark minus bright dots
conventions.numbers: integers exact; every other number rounded to 10 significant digits (floor(x + 0.5) on the tenth digit of the exact decimal value); features are computed from the rounded dots
conventions.before_selection: mean over the candidate index j of the statistic on the set made of candidate j of every target

correlation_with_log2_count.rule: Pearson correlation over the images of the set between log2 count and the feature; 0 when either is constant. before_selection: see conventions

selection_effect.rule: per selection quantity (a)-(e), means over the targets of: the mean over the target candidates (candidates_mean), the kept candidate (kept_mean), and the share of the other candidates with a smaller value than the kept one (kept_rank_mean: 0 = the kept candidate has the smallest value, 1 = the largest)
